blocks.text: Carbonyl group >C=O hi aldehydes aur ketones ki chemistry tay karta hai. Carbonyl compounds ke do bunyadi (basic) reactions hain:

items: Nucleophilic addition reactions (C=O par kisi nucleophile ka jurna)
Alpha (α) carbon ke khaas reactions (α carbon woh carbon hai jo carbonyl carbon ke bilkul saath hai)

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Nucleophilic addition ki misalein 23.3.1 mein hain (HCN, hydride ion, 2,4-DNPH). Alpha carbon ke reaction ki misal iodoform test hai (23.3.2), jis mein CH₃CO– group ke α carbon par iodine lagti hai.

blocks.prompt: Carbonyl compounds ke do bunyadi reactions ke naam batayein.
blocks.explanation: C=O group par nucleophilic addition, aur alpha (α) carbon ke khaas reactions.

items: Carbonyl compounds ke do bunyadi reactions: nucleophilic addition aur α-carbon reactions.
